import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from evaluate_d3 import summary as d3_summary
from evaluate import ACTIONS, OLD, PROMPTS, asset
from summarize import metrics
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

ROOT = OLD.parent
HISTORY = ROOT / "duplex-history-windows-coreai-2026-11-13.json"
BUNDLE = Path("/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
BUDGET = 500
LABELS = {
    "zh": ("历史对话", "缓冲区用户输入", "（空）",
           "根据以上用户历史对话，判断以下最新用户输入：【{transcript}】应该：1. 打断；2. 舍弃；3. 进入队列等待下一轮。",
           "动作定义："),
    "en": ("Conversation history", "Buffered user input", "(empty)",
           "Based on the conversation history above, decide what to do with the latest user input [{transcript}]: 1. Interrupt; 2. Discard; 3. Queue for the next turn.",
           "Action definitions:"),
}
# Each pair keeps the latest utterance identical while varying preceding input.
BUFFER_PAIRS = (
    (("需要保留原照片吗？", "先让我想一下。", "enqueue"),
     ("原照片已经保存，我继续介绍。", "小李，你那份也保存了对吗？", "discard"), "对。"),
    (("我正在讲解三个步骤。", "我只需要第一个步骤。", "interrupt"),
     ("我现在空闲。", "小李，你可以等一下。", "discard"), "先停一下。"),
    (("我继续念这封邮件。", "我有个问题，等你念完。", "enqueue"),
     ("我继续念这封邮件。", "爸，这句我在跟你说。", "discard"), "等一下再说。"),
    (("我正在把亮度调到八十。", "亮度不对，我希望你现在改。", "interrupt"),
     ("我正在把亮度调到八十。", "这次先照旧，下一次再改。", "enqueue"), "四十就好。"),
)
USERS = ("帮我处理照片。", "介绍一下这三个步骤。", "读一下这封邮件。", "调一下灯光。")


def cases():
    rows = []
    for entry in json.loads(HISTORY.read_text())["cases"]:
        if entry["suite"] != "history-2":
            continue
        text = entry["compact"]
        history, latest = text.split("\n历史：\n", 1)[1].rsplit("\n最新用户转写：", 1)
        rows.append(dict(id=entry["id"], suite="history-2", expected=entry["expected"], history=history,
                         buffer=[], transcript=json.loads(latest)))
    assert len(rows) == 28
    for index, (first, second, latest) in enumerate(BUFFER_PAIRS):
        for side, (assistant, buffered, expected) in enumerate((first, second)):
            rows.append(dict(id=f"buffer-{index+1}-{side+1}", suite="buffer-pairs", expected=expected,
                             history=f"用户：{USERS[index]}\n助手：{assistant}", buffer=[buffered], transcript=latest))
    return rows


def prompt_parts(case, language):
    history, buffer, empty, question, definitions = LABELS[language]
    state = f"【{history}】\n{case['history']}\n\n【{buffer}】\n" + ("\n".join(case["buffer"]) or empty)
    transcript = case["transcript"]
    rules = PROMPTS[language].splitlines()[6:9]
    assert [line[:3] for line in rules] == ["1. ", "2. ", "3. "]
    return state, question.format(transcript=transcript) + "\n\n" + "\n".join([definitions, *rules])


async def run_d3(rows):
    sys.path.insert(0, str(BUNDLE))
    from coreai_d3 import D3CoreAI
    from d3_format import render
    model = await D3CoreAI.load(BUNDLE)
    variants = {}
    for lang in LABELS:
        measured = []
        prompts = []
        for case in rows[:3] + rows:
            start = time.perf_counter()
            state, instructions = prompt_parts(case, lang)
            question = dict(type="choice", instructions=instructions, criteria={"1": None, "2": None, "3": None})
            scores, keys, tokens = await model.logits(state, question)
            assert keys == ["1", "2", "3"]
            selected = int(scores.argmax())
            measured.append(dict(id=case["id"], suite=case["suite"], expected=case["expected"],
                                 prediction=ACTIONS[selected], digit=keys[selected], logits=scores.tolist(),
                                 inputTokens=int(tokens["input_ids"].shape[1]), elapsedMS=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
            prompts.append(render(model.tokenizer, state, question, model.config["codes"]))
        variants[f"d3-{lang}"] = dict(rows=measured[3:], prompts=prompts[3:])
    return variants


def run_qwen(rows, lang, original):
    graph, source = asset("q15", original)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(graph.parent / "tokenizer", local_files_only=True)
    vocab = tokenizer.get_vocab()
    stops = {tokenizer.eos_token_id, vocab.get("<|im_end|>"), vocab.get("<|endoftext|>")} - {None}
    config = dict(name="q15", model=str(graph), candidateIDs=[], contextLimit=512, stopIDs=sorted(stops),
                  vocabSize=json.loads((graph.parent/"metadata.json").read_text())["language"]["vocab_size"], cases=[])
    prompts = []
    for case in rows:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        text = "\n\n".join(prompt_parts(case, lang))
        prompt = tokenizer.apply_chat_template([{"role": "user", "content": text}],
                                               tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
        ids = tokenizer.encode(prompt, add_special_tokens=False)
        assert len(ids) + 10 <= 512
        config["cases"].append(dict(id=case["id"], suite=case["suite"], ids=ids,
                                    maxTokens=10, tokenizationMS=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000))
        prompts.append(prompt)
    path = Path(f"history-buffer-q15-{lang}.input.json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(config))
    completed = subprocess.run(["../runner", str(path), "coreai-sequential"],
                               env=dict(os.environ, HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1"), capture_output=True, check=True, text=True)
    header, *measured = [json.loads(line) for line in completed.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
    for row, case in zip(measured, rows, strict=True):
        assert (row["id"], row["suite"]) == (case["id"], case["suite"])
        raw = tokenizer.decode(row["tokens"], skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)
        digit = raw.strip()
        row.update(raw=raw, expected=case["expected"],
                   prediction=ACTIONS[int(digit)-1] if row["stopped"] and digit in {"1","2","3"} else None)
    with (graph/"main.mlirb").open("rb") as f:
        source["graphSha256"] = hashlib.file_digest(f,"sha256").hexdigest()
    return dict(rows=measured, prompts=prompts, runtime=header, source=source)


def main():
    original = json.loads(OLD.read_text())
    rows = cases()
    variants = asyncio.run(run_d3(rows))
    for lang in LABELS:
        variants[f"q15-{lang}"] = run_qwen(rows, lang, original)
    for name, run in variants.items():
        summarize = (lambda part: d3_summary(part, BUDGET)) if name.startswith("d3") else metrics
        run["bySuite"] = {suite: summarize([row for row in run["rows"] if row["suite"] == suite])
                          for suite in ("history-2", "buffer-pairs")}
        print(name, run["bySuite"], flush=True)
    referenced = ROOT / "duplex-llm-bilingual-digits-coreai-2026-11-14.json"
    evidence = dict(date="2026-11-14", host=original["device"], cases=rows, runs=variants, budgetMS=BUDGET,
                    inputEvidenceSHA256={p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (HISTORY, referenced)},
                    reproductionSource=Path(__file__).read_text())
    Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
